checks.exercise: Decline dumbbell fly with fixed 20-degree elbow bend
checks.equipment: Thirty-degree decline bench, head pad, elevated foot platform and two dumbbells
checks.setup: 머리가 낮아지는 디클라인 벤치에 등과 머리를 대고 눕는다. 양발을 지지대에 단단히 올리고 덤벨을 가슴 위로 든다.
checks.hands: Neutral closed grips and symmetric fly arc
checks.feet: Fixed flat feet on supported elevated platform
checks.movement: 손바닥을 마주 보게 하고 팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 각도를 유지한다. 덤벨을 옆으로 벌렸다가 가슴 위로 모은다.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; not captured human motion.
Elevated foot platform represents one supported setup; no bench entry or exit.
Sampled equipment/body and support checks; not exhaustive mesh collision certification.
